items.title: Take over
items.web: Tap Take over to use the desktop. Assistants pause until you tap Hand back.
items.ios: Tap Take over to use the desktop. Assistants pause until you tap Hand back.

items.title: Click and drag
items.web: Tap to click where you tapped. One finger drags.
items.ios: Tap to click where you tapped. One finger drags.

items.title: Right-click
items.web: Tap with two fingers, or press and hold.
items.ios: Tap with two fingers, or press and hold.

items.title: Zoom in
items.web: Pinch to zoom. Zoomed in, two fingers pan instead of scrolling. Reset zoom appears below the desktop.
items.ios: Pinch to zoom. Zoomed in, two fingers pan instead of scrolling. Reset zoom is in the ⋯ menu.

items.title: Type
items.web: Tap Type text below the desktop, then Send text. Enter, Tab and Backspace have their own buttons.
items.ios: Tap the keyboard button in the bottom bar.

items.title: Copy and paste
items.web: Copy on the desktop first, then tap Copy to device. Paste from device types this device's clipboard into the selected field.
items.ios: Tap the clipboard button in the bottom bar for Copy to {device} and Paste from {device}. Copy on the desktop first.

items.title: Trackpad mode
items.web: Turn on Trackpad below the desktop. Your finger moves the pointer; tap to click there, double-tap and hold to drag. Recenter pointer if it drifts.
items.ios: Turn on from the ⋯ menu. Your finger moves the pointer; tap to click there, double-tap and hold to drag. Recenter pointer if it drifts.
